''''' Advances in Operator Theory''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] established in 2016 by [[Mohammad Sal Moslehian]] and published by  [[Birkhäuser]] on behalf of the [[Tusi Mathematical Research Group]]. It covers [[functional analysis]] and [[operator theory]] and related topics. 

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in [[Scopus]],<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/21100875757 | title=Scopus preview - Scopus - Advances in Operator Theory }}</ref> [[MathSciNet]],<ref>{{cite web | url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/mrcit/journal_list.html | title=MR: Reference List Journals & Series }}</ref> [[Emerging Sources Citation Index]], and ''[[Zentralblatt MATH]]''.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://zbmath.org/serials | title=Serials Search - zbMATH Open }}</ref>
